title: ProActive Athlete Heart Program: Proposal for Cardiac Risk Screening in Former High-Intensity Athletes
official: ProActive Athlete Heart Program: Proposal for Cardiac Risk Screening in Former High-Intensity Athletes
summary: AI-Guided Coronary CT Angiography Screening in Former High-Intensity Athletes
conditions: Coronary Atherosclerosis Due to Calcified Coronary Lesion
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Former professional or collegiate high-intensity athletes (e.g., NFL alumni, Division I athletes, or equivalent competitive-level participants).
* Age ≥30 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* eGFR \<40 mL/min/1.73 m²
* Known iodinated contrast allergy
* Weight \>450 lbs. (scanner table limit)
* Inability to hold breath \>10 seconds
* Uncontrolled arrhythmia
* Contraindication to beta-blocker, Calcium Channel Blockers and nitroglycerin
* Taking part in another research study that has not given their permission to participate in this one
* Pregnancy

sites.f: Baylor Scott & White The Heart Hospital- Plano
